facts.fact: The article states that the BCEAO published instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services in the UEMOA in January 2024.
facts.system: BCEAO Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services

facts.fact: The article states that, by a BCEAO communique of 2 April 2026, from 30 June 2026 all UEMOA financial institutions (banks, microfinance institutions, e-money institutions and payment institutions) must be connected to the PI-SPI instant payment platform; 80 institutions were already connected.
